items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: I went down with Curtis Mosby, who had the Apex Club down on Central. And I traveled with him for a few months.

ctx.x: Who else came to the Cotton Club that you heard?

Well, after Louis's first trip here, then we sort of shifted the -- well, I went out of the club, and I went down with Curtis Mosby, who had the Apex Club down on Central. And I traveled with him for a few months.

We -- the Apex had a policy. We would play one month in Los Angeles, then we'd go to San Francisco and play one month. And they would take the show from L. A. and play it in San Francisco. Then they would come back to Los Angeles to change the show for the next tour.
